title: Isolating a fault with a reference gauge
captions: A warning light is a claim. A second gauge checks it.
Read each line now and again ten minutes later.
The line that falls while the others hold is the fault.
Isolate only that line, then check that it holds.
verify: Decision choice clicks are added after a --dump of the M4-20 panel (Choice_<field>_<id> names).
